The process involves soaking, application of soap, and physical scrubbing, which are effective in loosening and removing the baked-on materials. The progression demonstrates the effectiveness of the cleaning method, with the final frame showing the dish nearly ready for rinsing or a final wash, highlighting the transition from dirty to clean through the stages of manual dishwashing.
